programs.title: Track 29
programs.desc: Dennis Potter's psychological drama with Gary Oldman and Theresa Russell. The life of a sexually-frustrated wife gets a little too exciting when a handsome stranger rocks up.

programs.title: Canyon Passage
programs.desc: Frontier western starring Dana Andrews. An ambitious businessman journeys to rural Oregon where a complex web of life and love waits to ensnare him. Directed by Jacques Tourneur.

programs.title: Drums Along the Mohawk
programs.desc: John Ford western with Henry Fonda and Claudette Colbert. In 1776, a settler and his wife attempt to farm in the Mohawk Valley but face attacks from Native Americans and the English.

programs.title: It Came from Outer Space
programs.desc: Richard Carlson stars as an astronomer who sees an alien craft land. But nobody believes him - until the cloning starts in Jack Arnold's science-fiction classic.
